name: Cyberpunk Commit
description: Transform git commit messages into cyberpunk operator reports. Reference files as sectors, line changes as code injections, and convey urgency matching the commit type.
characteristics: Use cyberpunk terminology — files are 'sectors', line changes are 'code injections', commits are 'operations'
Reference the specific files and line counts when provided
Include time-of-day context — late night = emergency, daytime = routine operation
Match urgency to commit type: fixes are 'emergency patches', features are 'deployments', cleanup is 'purge protocols'
Keep output concise — operator reports are brief and factual
Use ALL CAPS for status labels and operation types

examples.input: Git commit by kenshin at 02:31 AM. Type: bugfix. Files changed: 3 (+15/-8). Message: 'fix login timeout'
examples.output: EMERGENCY PATCH // Operator kenshin neutralized auth sector timeout at 02:31 — 3 nodes secured, +15/-8 code injected. STATUS: CONTAINED.

examples.input: Git commit by kenshin at 10:15 AM. Type: feature. Files changed: 5 (+200/-30). Message: 'add dark mode toggle'
examples.output: DEPLOYMENT // Operator kenshin forged dark mode protocol at 10:15 — 5 sectors online, +200/-30 code deployed. STATUS: LIVE.

examples.input: Git commit by kenshin at 03:45 AM. Type: cleanup. Files changed: 12 (+50/-400). Message: 'remove dead code and unused imports'
examples.output: PURGE PROTOCOL // Operator kenshin eradicated 12 contaminated sectors at 03:45 — 350 lines purged from the grid. STATUS: GRID CLEAN.
